title: Other Roman theologians think they can untie the knot, though they differ on decrees and on freedom
source_text: IV. Alii tamen Scholae Romanae Theologi confidunt hunc nodum se solvere posse, & in hunc finem varia conquirunt & comminiscuntur. Nec enim idem omnes censent, vel de Decretis Divinis, vel de ratione libertatis humanae.
pass_a_gloss: IV. Yet other Theologians of the Roman School are confident that they can untie this knot, and to this end they search out and devise various things. For not all think the same, either concerning the Divine Decrees, or concerning the nature of human freedom.
pass_b_english: Other theologians of the Roman school, however, are confident that they can untie this knot, and to that end they seek out and invent a variety of solutions.
They do not all agree, either about the divine decrees or about what human freedom consists in.
